# Assets · Logos

4 files under `assets/Logos/`, held in the artifact’s asset store: fetch one with the Artifact tool’s `read`, the id below as `path` (they are not files beside the page — a read by file path fails), then upload it to your own artifact as an asset (`publish`, `asset:true`; or `upload_asset`, where your tool lists that); an SVG may also be inlined. Copy assets, never approximate them.

## Use

```html
<img src="<the url the asset upload returned for tecnotaller-logo-original.png>" alt="…">
```

## Usage notes

# Logos

- `tecnotaller-logo-original.png` — Logo completo (isotipo + palabra). Archivo maestro, fondo blanco.
- `tecnotaller-isotipo.svg` — Redibujo vectorial de la T bicolor (navy + blue). Web, favicon, documentos.
- `tecnotaller-isotipo-mono.svg` — T a una tinta en `currentColor`: sellos, recibos, fondos de color.
- `tecnotaller-icono-app.svg` — Ícono de app: T blanca/azul sobre cuadrado navy redondeado.
